name: Dai-ichi Life
decisive: P/EV 0.68x = discount to global peers BUT the TOP of its own 10-yr band (0.4-0.6x) — the value-up re-rate is largely PRICED; buying at 99.1% of the 52wk high is a carry entry, not deep value. Sell-side targets sit BELOW spot; ~35% foreign-owned; THE consensus global trade (crowded).
corrections: web-claimed 'Y9T bond loss' REFUTED: filing shows -Y3,415bn, 98% policy-reserve-matching (liability-offset one-sided J-GAAP mark) — does NOT constrain buybacks (ESR ~220% governs)
'Protective ~40% of profit' overstated: PLC alone ~15-18%; overseas TOTAL targets >40%
verified: rate convexity neutral-to-mild-positive BY DESIGN (rate risk only 3% of required capital; benefit = EV/spread +Y24bn not a capital windfall)
Protective US credit tail small/covered (office CML ~1.4% of assets, LTV 49%, DSCR 1.80; CLO line UNVERIFIABLE)
FY26: profit Y560bn + DPS Y72 (+32%, payout 50%+) but NO fresh buyback authorized — discretionary (p~60% by Nov) = the near-term letdown risk
left_tail: disorderly-JGB (mass-lapse channel, not the bond mark) + yen-slide are CORRELATED (fiscal disorder) = the unhedgeable USD double-hit; cap the JPY sleeve

plan.now: 1/3-slot small starter (optional) to hold BoJ Jul-30/31 + Q1 (~Aug 7-14) optionality
plan.scale: September dry powder, prefer a 5-8% dip or post-BoJ; NEVER chase full size at the high

no_red_team_rationale: edge claim (~30% of case) is conceded by the DD's own falsifier ('re-rate largely priced; holds only as fair-carry'); action is a small optional starter — the red-team rule polices conviction-sized edge claims (FUTU/PODD/IVN/EG class), not self-demoted carry (LULU/LG class)
kill_triggers: Protective credit event / levering US M&A

edge_explainer.market_believes: Japan value-up is real and Dai-ichi executes it — buy the compounding: buybacks, cross-holding sales, rising rates.
edge_explainer.we_believe: All true — and mostly paid. On embedded value the stock sits at the top of its own decade band; what remains is honest carry (~3.9% forward yield + EV compounding) plus BoJ/buyback optionality.
edge_explainer.why_we_might_have_edge: Small: global-peer EV convergence (0.68x vs 0.9-1.1x) if governance reform sustains — but sell-side targets below spot say the local market disagrees.
edge_explainer.why_it_might_be_priced_in: It IS mostly priced — that's the finding. Crowded consensus trade at a 52-week high.
edge_explainer.what_resolves_it: BoJ Jul-30/31, Q1 print ~Aug 7-14 (est), the H1-Nov buyback decision (p~60%).
edge_explainer.mechanism_falsifier: As ALPHA it's already falsified by its own band position; holds only as fair-carry + optionality. As CARRY it dies on a BoJ reversal or a disorderly-JGB lapse event.
edge_explainer.edge_type: September-class JPY carry; 15% withholding drag noted; small starter only this year

sizing: 1-1.5% starter (September-class parking w/ upside; JPY sleeve cap applies)

catalyst_overlays.event: BoJ path (terminal ~1.25%; consensus one more 2026 hike)
catalyst_overlays.call: WAIVED w/ note: ~70% one+ hike = POSITIVE for the EEV; the census KILLED the stale upper-house-election overlay (was Jul-2025)

exit_band_20260806.classification: TRIM-BAND (the record's own trim flag, converted from prose into resting orders)
exit_band_20260806.why_this_one_is_mandatory: The ledger already carries an explicit, dated, UNEXECUTED instruction: 'TRIM-INTO-STRENGTH FLAG (2026-08-07 print) ... TRIM a portion into the print (bank the run-up), hold the core; decide the trim size BEFORE the date, not after the drop.' That flag has been sitting in prose. The HUBS precedent is exactly this — a trim-into-strength flag left in prose cost ~$2,600 unexecuted. It becomes resting orders here.

valuation_anchors.record_own_trim_trigger: kill_triggers[] contains verbatim: 'P/EV >0.85x w/o EV growth (trim)'. 0.85 x Y2,712 = Y2,305 — the second rung is the record's own number, not a new one.

rungs.anchor: the pre-print run-up leg — banks +9.2% over cost on strength into/through the 08-07 Q1 (P/EV ~0.76x)
P/EV 0.85x = the record's OWN written trim trigger

upside_trim_RESTING.keep_resting_through_the_08_07_print: YES — deliberately. §6 default is that exits ride events, and here the flag WANTS the trim banked into the print: the stock is +42% YTD near an all-time high, the operating beat and the rate-normalization/capital-return story are consensus, and the reaction call is frozen LOW. Selling a pop is benign regardless of its cause; a one-sided-downside setup is the best possible thing for a resting sell to sit above.
upside_trim_RESTING.cancel_below_reason: -11% vs cost. Below this the BoJ/carry premise is under review and the band must be re-derived before a bounce can auto-sell into it (the HUBS-182 pattern).

exit_band_20260806.catalyst_review_basis: Q1 FY27 print 2026-08-07 (given). Forced re-derive same week. Next after that: the H1/November buyback decision (p~60%) — the record's named near-term letdown risk.
unverifiable: EV/share is inferred from the court's P/EV ratio and its live price, not read from a fresh EEV disclosure — an updated EEV at the print moves the 0.85x line
exit_band_20260806.doctrine: UPSIDE TRIMS rest as GTC SELL limits (fills-on-strength are wrong-side-safe). DOWNSIDE KILLS are ALERT-class only — never resting stops. Trims KEEP RESTING through scheduled events; they are catalyst-REVIEWED (forced re-derive), not pulled.
exit_band_20260806.tax_regime: All lots acquired Jul/Aug-2026 => SHORT-TERM until ~Jul-2027. Desk convention ST ~50% (fed 37% + NIIT 3.8% + CA 13.3% = ~54% all-in). A foreign trim realizes the USD gain INCLUDING the FX leg: basis is struck at trade-date FX, proceeds at fill-date FX.
exit_band_20260806.fx_note: FX moved the book's way since the July fills: USDJPY 162.5->157.7 (yen +3.0%), EUR 1.1414->1.1559, GBP 1.3251->1.3467, PLN 0.2650->0.2691, DKK 0.1527->0.1546. Every foreign rung below carries a small positive FX component inside the taxable gain; the JPY names carry the largest (~3%).
